This season I will put a little chemical fertilizer on this maize plot because maize is important for my household, but I cannot afford to use a lot. I will also plant improved seed and add some manure where I can, since that helps the crop on my small piece of land. I depend mostly on family work, and because this is a rainfed plot in Machinga, I will not irrigate. I do not expect to use pesticide or herbicide on this field.
